source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.3.1, printed page 150.

blocks.text: Law of mass action ke mutabiq reactants ki concentration jitni zyada, reaction utni tezi se chalti hai. Jab ek ya zyada reactants ki concentration barhti hai to rate barhti hai, kyunke zyada concentration react karne wale zarraat ke darmiyan zyada collisions deti hai, jo reaction tez karte hain. Zyada reactant zarraat wala dabba kam wale se tez react karta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain
blocks.text: Gaseous reactants wali reactions ke liye dabao barhne se gases ki concentration aur yun reaction ki rate barhti hai. Agar reactants solids ya liquids hon to dabao ki tabdeeli ka rate par koi asar nahi.

blocks.prompt: Hydrogen aur oxygen ke mixture ko dabane se un ki reaction tez kyun hoti hai, jabke thos zinc aur patli acid wale flask ko dabane se nahi?
blocks.explanation: Gases ko dabane se un ke molecules qareeb aate hain, un ki concentration aur collisions ki frequency barhti hai. Solid ya liquid ka hajm dabao se mushkil se badalta hai, to zinc aur acid ki concentrations, aur collision frequency, be-tabdeel rehti hain.

items: Law of mass action: zyada concentration, zyada collisions, tez reaction; gases ke liye zyada dabao ka matlab zyada concentration aur tez rate, magar dabao solids ya liquids par asar nahi karta.
